rationale: S-0034-01 proposes a 2-D distal length x diameter sweep on the t0024 DSGC. The t0024 testbed has been de-emphasised since brainstorm 9; morphology variation experiments (research question Q2) should now be designed against the from-scratch substrate so that results are directly comparable to the rest of the from-scratch wave. The 2-D sweep idea remains valuable but should be re-formulated. Reprioritising from high to medium.
